## Ctx.renderEditVideoGroup() method

Replaces the current message with a video media group.

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderEditVideoGroup(data?: ITData | null, AGBaseId?: string | null, options?: ITOptReplyVideo | null, fallbackEdit?: ITOptFallbackEdit): Promise<unknown>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;unknown&gt;

The sent media group message object.

## Remarks

Deletes the original message and sends a new media group via `replyMediaGroup`<!-- -->. Useful when the template uses pipe-delimited `src` values.

```typescript

  await this.renderEditVideoGroup()
```
